scoring_justification: T1 recompute infeasible because the verifier cannot re-run full DFT+U calculations. Therefore we compare the agent's reported values from the output JSONs to the paper gold with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden gold values for dopant-O distances, Ce magnetic moment, adsorption energies and bond lengths from the paper (DFT+U)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 and text (Chemical Physics Letters 2010, DOI 10.1016/j.cplett.2010.04.035)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper: DFT+U distances for Ta and Nb as listed in Table 1; magnetic moment inferred to be ~1 μB from localization of one electron on Ce; adsorption energies and bond lengths taken from text.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual values reported in the published study for the DFT+U method; they serve as the reference for reproduction.

required.Ta: object with keys surface_distances (array of 4 numbers), subsurface_distances (array of 2 numbers), ce_magnetic_moment (number)
required.Nb: object with keys surface_distances (array of 4 numbers), subsurface_distances (array of 2 numbers), ce_magnetic_moment (number)

outputs.description: Dopant-oxygen distances and Ce magnetic moment for Ta- and Nb-doped CeO2(110) surfaces. Compared to paper-reported DFT+U values with tolerances.

required.Ta: object with keys adsorption_energy (number), n_o_s (number), n_o_n (number)
required.Nb: object with keys adsorption_energy (number), n_o_s (number), n_o_n (number)

outputs.description: NO2 adsorption energy and N-O bond lengths for Ta- and Nb-doped CeO2(110) surfaces. Adsorption energy scored threshold_or_better; bond lengths scored exact_match within tolerances.

output_contract.notes: HSE06 calculations and undoped surface tests omitted per taskability scope. Only DFT+U (U=5 eV on Ce 4f) is required.

steps.description: Score dopant-O distances and Ce magnetic moment for Ta and Nb doped surfaces.
